H4572.name: Maadai
H4572.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4572.brief: One of the men who married foreign women during Ezra's time
H4572.short: Maadai was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H4597.name: Maai
H4597.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4597.brief: Levite musician who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
H4597.short: Maai, a Levite musician, participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during the time of Nehemiah.

H4590G.name: Maaziah
H4590G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4590G.brief: Priest who served in the 24th division
H4590G.short: Maaziah was the head of the 24th priestly division during the time of David.

H4590H.name: Maaziah
H4590H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4590H.brief: Priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H4590H.short: Maaziah, also known as Maadiah or Moadiah, was a priest who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

H4506B.name: Manahath
H4506B.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4506B.short: Manahath was a son of Shobal, a Horite.

H4519H.name: Manasseh
H4519H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4519H.brief: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah.
H4519H.short: Manasseh, son of Hezekiah, was a king of Judah who reigned for 55 years.

H4519I.name: Manasseh
H4519I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4519I.brief: Descendant of Pahath-moab, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4519I.short: Manasseh, a descendant of Pahath-moab, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4519J.name: Manasseh
H4519J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4519J.brief: Descendant of Hashum, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4519J.short: Manasseh, a descendant of Hashum, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4519G.name: Manasseh
H4519G.desc: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4519G.brief: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.
H4519G.short: Manasseh, Joseph's firstborn, was blessed by Jacob and became a tribe of Israel.

H4582.name: Maoch
H4582.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4582.brief: Father of Achish, king of Gath.
H4582.short: Maoch (or Maacah) was the father of Achish, king of Gath, to whom David fled.

H4584H.name: Maon
H4584H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4584H.brief: Son of Shammai, a descendant of Caleb.
H4584H.short: Maon, a son of Shammai, was a descendant of Caleb.

H4505.name: Menahem
H4505.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4505.brief: King of Israel who reigned for ten years.
H4505.short: Menahem, king of Israel, known for his cruelty and for paying tribute to Assyria.

H4506H.name: Menuhoth
H4506H.short: Menuhoth, a clan descended from Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H4587.name: Meonothai
H4587.brief: Son of Othniel and father of Ophrah.
H4587.short: Meonothai, son of Othniel, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H4586H.name: Meunim
H4586H.brief: A group of temple servants who returned from exile.
H4586H.short: The Meunim were a group of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H4586G.name: Meunites
H4586G.brief: A people group who were enemies of Israel.
H4586G.short: The Meunites were a people group who lived near Israel and were enemies of God's people.

H4509G.name: Miniamin
H4509G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4509G.short: Miniamin, a Levite, assisted in distributing the offerings and tithes to his fellow Levites during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H4509H.name: Miniamin
H4509H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4509H.brief: A priest who played a trumpet in Nehemiah's time.
H4509H.short: Miniamin, a priest, was among those who played trumpets at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

H4558.name: Mispar
H4558.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4558.brief: One of the returnees from Babylonian exile.
H4558.short: Mispar, also known as Mispereth, was among the first group of exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon under the leadership of Zerubbabel.

H4506A.name: Manahath
H4506A.brief: A place where Benjamites lived after the exile
H4506A.short: Manahath (Nohah), a place where some Benjamites lived after returning from the Babylonian exile (<ref="1Ch.8.6">1Ch.8.6</ref>).

H4584G.name: Maon
H4584G.brief: A city in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail
H4584G.short: Maon, a city in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:55">Joshua 15:55</ref>), home of Nabal and Abigail (<ref="1Sa.25.2">1Sa.25.2</ref>).

H4532.name: Massah
H4532.brief: A place where the Israelites tested God
H4532.short: Massah, a place in the wilderness where the Israelites tested the Lord by demanding water (<ref="Exodus 17:7; Deu.6.16; 9:22; 33:8; Psalm 95:8">Exodus 17:7; Deu.6.16; 9:22; 33:8; Psalm 95:8</ref>).

H4508.name: Minni
H4508.brief: A kingdom allied with Ararat and Ashkenaz
H4508.short: Minni, a kingdom mentioned alongside Ararat and Ashkenaz, was called to battle against Babylon.

H4511.name: Minnith
H4511.brief: An Ammonite town known for its wheat
H4511.short: Minnith, an Ammonite town, was known for its wheat and was a place of defeat for the Ammonites by Jephthah.

H4507.name: Destiny
H4507.brief: A pagan deity mentioned in the Book of Isaiah
H4507.short: Destiny, mentioned in <ref="Isaiah 65:11">Isaiah 65:11</ref>, is a pagan deity associated with fate or fortune, which some Israelites worshipped, forsaking the Lord.
